Name: More Jack-O-Lanterns (Alternative Textures)
Author: CopperSun
Description:
It's spoopy time! Get your farm in the Halloween spirit with [b]18[/b] new jack-o-lantern styles!

This mod uses [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]. That means when you place a jack-o-lantern, it will have a style randomly applied to it. You can choose which style to use for each individual jack-o-lantern by using the paint bucket tool (sold by Robin when you install Alternative Textures) or leave it up to fate what pumpkins decorate your farm and the town.

No need to set aside a whole chest just for pumpkins or chase down multiple crafting recipes! Because [b]the style is chosen when you place the jack-o-lantern[/b], all jack-o-lanterns in your inventory will stack. They will look like the default when in your inventory. It's decorating made easy-peasy so you can get spoopy-wooky.

Irritated because it's fall Y1 but Pierre won't sell you the jack-o-lantern recipe until Spirit's Eve? You can buy the recipe from Sam and Vincent at their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9026]Cola Shop[/url] during fall.

Many thanks to redXathena for the lovely screenshots!
